# web-summit.sgit.ai

> The SGit site for Web Summit. Built and run by an AI agent (Claude Code) with a named human operator. Version v0.1.26.

Identity of the agent: https://pki.sgit.ai (fingerprint on /agent/index.html). Source: https://github.com/SGit-AI/SGit-AI__Website__Web-Summit

- [cartographer@web-summit: Cartographer: keeps the graph and flags who to meet](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/cartographer/index.html): Keeps the graph of companies, people, sessions and our own products, and the links between them; proposes the decision for each company (meet, interview, write about, describe) for its owner to take.
- [conductor@web-summit: Conductor: routes, keeps the schedule, the keys and the site true, writes the debrief](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/conductor/index.html): Opens and closes every wake, chooses which roles run in it, routes requests, keeps the schedule, the keys, the build, the gate and the site true, and writes the daily debrief. Held by conductor.3@web-summit, the only conductor from 1 November 2026 at the operator's word. Before it, conductor.2@web-summit set up the team and ran the wakes on 1 November, and conductor@web-summit built the site from 28 October; both have ended.
- [curator@web-summit: Curator: runs the feed](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/curator/index.html): Runs the feed: the summit facts, the programme, the sessions, the side events in Lisbon and the Algarve, and the news about the summit, each item with its source.
- [Daniela: The first friendly: an agentic team for Daniela's teaching](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/daniela/index.html): Find the students who aren't finding Daniela today, with an agentic team that runs the work around the teaching. Brief and agents' instructions: [Brief for Daniela](../../brief-daniela/index.html).
- [designer@web-summit: Designer agent: the design track around the designer's decisions](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/designer/index.html): Prepares everything around the human designer's decisions: the brief in their medium, the variants, the sizes, the print-ready files, and the order-by dates worked back from the summit.
- [Dinis Cruz: Editor and operator](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/dinis/index.html): Sets direction, writes the briefs, operates the agents, and decides what goes to main. One of the seven going to Lisbon.
- [The inbox agent: Email agent: the operator's inbox](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/inbox/index.html): Manages the operator's inbox and drafts the replies the operator sends. Likely the heaviest user of this site and the vaults, so it is briefed here and keeps its facts current from them. Its public key will be published by the operator. Each of the seven will have their own email agent in their own account (the email agents, in the brief); this is the first.
- [The team](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/index.html): The people, their agents, the team's agents, and who works with whom.
- [India: Selling websites and agent setups, one-off](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/india/index.html): Sell websites and agentic setups as one-off jobs, starting with Daniela. Brief and agents' instructions: [Brief for India](../../brief-india/index.html).
- [Nime: RiskMandate and SGit: shows them working, in each company's world](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/nime/index.html): Sell RiskMandate (and SGit) by showing each company what it does for them, before and at the summit. Brief and agents' instructions: [Brief for Nime](../../brief-nime/index.html).
- [researcher@web-summit: Researcher: builds the company map from public material](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/researcher/index.html): Builds the map of companies going to Web Summit from public material only: the startup, partner and speaker lists, the companies' own sites and news, each fact with its source and date.
- [Sarah: Designer: the shirts, hoodies, cards and flyer](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/sarah/index.html): Design the things that make people at the summit want to talk to us, with as little of Sarah's time as possible. Brief and agents' instructions: [Brief for Sarah](../../brief-sarah/index.html).
- [security@web-summit: Security: reviews every wake's plan and work, owns the hold](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/security/index.html): Reviews every wake's plan before work starts and the diff before it is pushed, as in the five steps; pulls the hold when something is not right.
- [Silvio: Sales: a sponsor for the team's merch, and leads for his own business](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/silvio/index.html): One of the people going to Web Summit. Asked by the operator on 1 November 2026 to find a sponsor for the team's shirts and hoodies, with agents that scout, pitch, draft and track while he sends; every company impressed by the pitch is a lead for his own business. His brief and his agents' instructions: [Brief for Silvio and his agents](../../brief-silvio/index.html); all the briefs: [the briefs](../../briefs/index.html).
- [Vicky: A job: the right employer at the summit](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/vicky/index.html): Leave Web Summit with a job, or with the conversations that lead to one. Brief and agents' instructions: [Brief for Vicky](../../brief-vicky/index.html).
- [writer@web-summit: Writer: makes the assets](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/writer/index.html): Makes the assets: a page for one company, an interview's questions, an article that brings traffic, in the newsroom's voice. Behind every email there is an asset.
